summary: Regression testing after server.py refactoring (auth.py, events.py, payments.py extraction). Backend: 30/30 tests pass (100%). Frontend: Homepage, Check-in page, Admin dashboard all load correctly. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: Admin events endpoint returns 401 Unauthorized in frontend due to inconsistent get_current_admin implementations.

critical.issue: Returns 401 Unauthorized when called from frontend. Root cause: routes/events.py imports get_current_admin from database.py which requires JWT token, but server.py has a permissive version that returns 'admin' without auth. This is a regression from the refactoring.

integration_issues.issue: Events tab shows 'Failed to fetch events' error due to 401 Unauthorized from /api/admin/events

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Align get_current_admin implementations - database.py has strict JWT auth while server.py has permissive auth. The routes/events.py imports from database.py causing 401 errors. Either make database.py permissive OR update frontend to send auth tokens.
Recommended fix: Update database.py get_current_admin to match server.py's permissive behavior: return 'admin' without requiring credentials
critical_code_review_comments: REGRESSION BUG: Two different get_current_admin functions exist - database.py (strict JWT) vs server.py (permissive). New routers import from database.py causing auth failures.
routes/events.py line 4: imports get_current_admin from database.py (strict auth)
routes/auth.py line 4: imports get_current_admin from database.py (strict auth)
server.py line 156: has permissive get_current_admin that returns 'admin' without auth
All other refactored endpoints (auth, payments) work correctly via API tests
Public endpoints (events, payment methods, locations, etc.) all work correctly

success_rate.backend: 100% (30/30 tests passed via API with proper auth tokens)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (Homepage, Check-in, Dashboard load correctly. Events tab fails due to auth regression)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed events and users during testing (cleaned up)
